Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the act was “Simply Red,” contradicting the evidence pointing to Blue and misinterpreting the label association. “Simply Red” is not an Innocent Records act and its name is not exactly a primary color word, whereas Blue (an Innocent Records act) achieved Platinum sales and directly matches an RGB primary color. This incorrect pivot to Simply Red was the first clear error.
